subject: POC evaluation playbook & owner ledger — next steps
messages:
From: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@brightfoundry.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: josh@brightfoundry.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC goals

Thanks for the call earlier, Markus. Quick recap from our side: BrightFoundry wants a 3-week hands-on eval to validate latency at 99th pct under their typical burst pattern and confirm that model outputs meet our retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) quality bar. Primary success criteria we care about:

- 99th-pct latency < 420ms for 1k qps burst samples
- Semantic-match F1 on our test set >= 0.78
- End-to-end security controls: VPC peering + audit logs visible to our SecOps

We have two internal owners: me (product) for quality and Josh (platform) for infra. Procurement will need a short SOW and an extension to our PO for reserved capacity if we proceed. Can you send a short playbook that maps out who owns infra, app integrations, security evidence, and the procurement steps? Also timeline assumptions (how long for onboarding + smoke tests) would be helpful.

Samantha
Product Lead, BrightFoundry

On Sun, 08 Nov 2026 at 14:05, markus_klein@redwood.com wrote:
> Thanks for taking the time — good alignment. Sending a more detailed playbook in the next message.
> — Markus

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@brightfoundry.com>
Cc: Josh Patel <josh@brightfoundry.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: POC evaluation playbook & owner ledger — draft

Samantha / Josh —

Thanks again. Per your ask, attached is a concise POC playbook and a proposed owner ledger so everyone knows who does what during the trial. High-level timeline (3-week lab):

Week 0 (1–3 days): Kickoff, network checks, credential handoffs
Week 1 (3–5 days): Model integration + baseline smoke tests
Week 2 (5 days): Load and latency profiling with your burst traces
Week 3 (5 days): Quality evals, regression checks, and go/no-go review

Key success criteria (as discussed):
- 99th-pct latency target: 420ms (measured on your representative traces)
- Quality target: semantic F1 >= 0.78 on BrightFoundry test set
- Security: VPC peering + streaming audit logs to your SIEM

Owner ledger (proposed):
- Infra & capacity (Redwood Dedicated infra & autoscaling) — Owner: lauren_bishop@redwood.com (primary), markus_klein@redwood.com (secondary)
- App integration (RAG connector, embedding pipeline) — Owner: josh@brightfoundry.com (primary), monica_patel@redwood.com (integration support)
- Security & evidence (VPC, audit logs, SOC2 artifacts) — Owner: neha_kapoor@redwood.com (primary), samantha.chen@brightfoundry.com (stakeholder)
- Procurement / SOW & PO — Owner: procurement@brightfoundry.com (primary), markus_klein@redwood.com (support)

Attachments: redwood-poc-playbook.pdf (short playbook + test checklist), network-checklist.xlsx (minimal firewall/peering checklist). I included a HubSpot link to the deal for your team's reference.

Next steps / asks for BrightFoundry:
1) Confirm the owner ledger above or propose alternates
2) Share sample trace file (gzip) + representative test set by Tue EOD so we can pre-config the runtime
3) Confirm procurement contact and any required PO terms (we can ship a 30-day trial SOW)

I'll loop in Neha and Monica internally to ensure security and integration ops are queued. Happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up tomorrow if you prefer.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com

- Network peering & firewall validation — Responsible: lauren_bishop; Consulted: josh@brightfoundry.com; Accountable: neha_kapoor (security sign-off)

If anyone needs runway or has conflicts this week, call it out now so I can propose alternatives.

Thanks —
Markus

Markus —

This is super helpful, thanks. Confirming:
1) Owners look fine to us — will loop Josh to ensure infra-side alignment with Lauren.
2) We'll upload the sample traces to the Drive folder you linked by Tue morning.
3) Procurement contact is procurement@brightfoundry.com — I've CC'd them. They requested the short SOW + trial terms; happy for you to send the 30-day trial SOW.

Best,
Samantha
